selected_candidate.knowledge: The repository convention maps source paths to namespaces using the directory structure under `src/` and `test/`. The alert API source file is `src/metabase/pulse/api/alert.clj` → namespace `metabase.pulse.api.alert`. Its test file is `test/metabase/pulse/api/alert_test.clj` → namespace `metabase.pulse.api.alert-test`. When adding a new Malli validation test file for alerts, the correct path following this convention would be `test/metabase/pulse/api/alert_malli_test.clj` with namespace `metabase.pulse.api.alert-malli-test`, not `test/metabase/api/alert_malli_test.clj` as listed in the task requirements.
